author: Yar
notes: 64x64 cells, 2:1 dimetric diamond floor (64x32 footprint). Upper rows: grass/dirt tiles, slopes, cliff blocks, waterfalls. Middle rows: water tiles and shore/edge transitions, water rocks. Lower rows: grass tufts, bushes, fallen logs, pine/oak/dead trees (props). Transparent background. PRIMARY STYLE anchor.

author: Yar
notes: Modular 64x64 building parts: stone/timber walls, doors, windows, roof pieces, stairs, interior furniture (tables, chairs, barrels-adjacent props). Compose houses, barracks, mills, market stalls from parts. Same palette/style as Yar outside tileset.

author: SketchyLogic
notes: 368x345 walled keep/castle with gate, tower, banners. Derivative: pure-white background keyed to transparent from original castle_3.png (RGB). Palette matches Yar sets well.

author: extradave
notes: 64x128 castle wall segments, towers, and rubble/damaged variants — useful for AoE-style walls, gates, and destruction states. Palette is browner than the Yar/SketchyLogic green-stone look; tint at runtime if needed.

author: SketchyLogic
notes: 24x~32 villagers in several outfits (peasant, robed, noble) plus caped soldiers and a grey mage; rows are 4-direction walk cycles. Derivative: pure-white background keyed to transparent from original CitizenSheet.png (RGB). Best villager/worker unit set.

author: FLAG
notes: 1376x1200 sheet of small isometric pixel people with 8-direction walk frames. Secondary/civilian variety.

author: Clint Bellanger
kind: animated character sheets, 8 directions (2048x2048, 256px cells; rows=directions, cols=frames: stance/walk/swing/cast/die)
notes: male_* light/heavy/unarmored are full-body soldier variants; male_longsword/longbow/shield/staff are weapon OVERLAYS to composite on male_base. magician is a robed caster. Fully animated — the rare animated-iso-unit coverage.

author: Clint Bellanger
kind: animated creature sheets, 8 directions (same grid layout as heroes)
notes: Skeleton/zombie read as undead raiders; elemental works as a specter/wraith; ogre as a brute. Same style and scale as the hero sheets.

author: FoshyTakashi
notes: Pixel fire loop at 32px (96x96 sheet) and 64px (192x192 sheet). Author note on page: 'As long as you are not selling these directly do whatever.'

author: AntumDeluge
notes: Looping smoke puff column for burning/producing buildings.
